name: nrf24l01p-pa-lna
title: nRF24L01+ PA/LNA module (SMA antenna)
description: nRF24L01+ with an RFX2401C power amplifier and low-noise amplifier and an external dipole antenna (e.g. E01-ML01DP5). Output power, LNA gain, antenna gain and current are estimates from module specifications; to be confirmed by measurement.
notes: Draws over 100 mA while sending: add a 10-100 uF capacitor across VCC and GND, or power it from its own 3.3 V regulator.
Two of these modules closer than about 1 m can overload each other's receiver; use a low power level on the bench.
